input.title: Has My Replacement Card Been Sent?
input.request: I need to know whether the replacement card ordered for my H&V account has actually been dispatched. The secure portal confirmed that my request was accepted, but I cannot see confirmation of delivery or dispatch.

events.text: Your replacement card request has been accepted. This confirms the request was received; it does not confirm dispatch or delivery.
I’m following up because the portal only says my replacement card request was accepted. Please check whether dispatch has been registered; I don’t have confirmation that the card has arrived.
I’m checking the card journal for the dispatch record associated with case HV-021. The customer has asked whether dispatch was registered; please return the recorded status only.

summary: Mara Ellison, an unverified customer on secure chat, asked whether dispatch had been registered for her replacement card. The desk classed it as a card status request, found the card system had already been asked, and closed the case as waiting because that system's answer hasn't come in. A second attempt to ask the card system was refused because the case was already in the waiting state, and no actions were taken, so the dispatch question remains unanswered until the card system replies.
